takeaways: Windows 365 and Azure Virtual Desktop deliver the same desktop; the real choice is who runs the control plane and how demand behaves.
Windows 365 prices per person and fits endpoint teams with flat, personal demand, while Azure Virtual Desktop prices consumption and rewards Azure-skilled teams with shared, moving demand.
Check licensing, network and identity first, pilot both models with the same users, and write down the trigger conditions for revisiting the decision.
hook: Teams often choose between Windows 365 and Azure Virtual Desktop by feature list or price sheet and then hand the platform to a team that cannot run it. This episode walks architects and IT decision-makers through cost, scaling, networking, identity, licensing, migration and operations. It ends with a five-question framework for matching each group of users to the right cloud PC model.
